journal.title: Traveller's Notes
journal.entry.1.title: 1. The Journey Begins
journal.entry.1.desc: Woke up in a strange world. The air feels crisp, and trees stretch out into the horizon. Must find shelter before nightfall.
journal.entry.2.title: 2. Deep Dark Caves
journal.entry.2.desc: Ventured underground today. Found veins of iron and heard the distant echo of running water. Need more torches.
